zh: 修复 Word 浅蓝选区无法直接编辑公式的问题，减少双击时的重复激活。逐一验证 30 个公式的打开和完整列表，并验证公式 26 的保存、重开与编号。补充自动检查更新及更新按钮的实测。
en: Fix editing equations selected as blue text in Word and avoid duplicate activation on double-click. Verified all 30 demo equations and full document lists, plus saving, reopening, and numbering for equation 26. Checked automatic update detection and the update button in the app.
